mechanism.name: financing-budget-scaled policy-rate-differential carry
mechanism.statement: Hold each pair in its evidenced policy-rate-differential direction with position size LINEAR in the carry-to-cost ratio, where the cost that defines the budget is the STRESS-TIER round trip, not the base-tier round trip. The book trades only at evidenced policy events (the differential is a step function that is constant between evidenced rate updates), so fill count is event-bound, not clock-bound, and a doubled cost assumption re-scales every size down by design instead of flipping the sign of the economics.
mechanism.conditioning_variable: Delta_r_i(t) = r_base_i(t) - r_quote_i(t), annualized policy-rate differential of pair i, where each leg's rate r_area(t) is the BIS WS_CBPOL level from the evidenced-vintage copy whose availability stamp derives from the pinned v2 announcement ledger (sha256 ae5e1f2e64b8aa7c08472755bd73857543aa89b72ea81b70ad5c5d81e7cd6bd4). The value used at decision clock t is the level of the most recent ledger row with first_readable_decision_utc <= t AND effective_date <= t (frozen-reader PIT invariant: available_time_utc <= decision_ts AND effective_time_utc <= decision_ts). No inferred stamps anywhere.
mechanism.cost_budget_constant: kappa = SAFETY x C_rt(tier 2.0) x (252 / H) with SAFETY = 2, C_rt(tier 2.0) = 2 x 1.5 bps x 2.0 = 6.0 bps round trip, H = 63 sessions intended minimum hold. kappa = 2 x 6 bps x (252/63) = 48 bps = 0.0048 annualized differential. At |Delta_r| = kappa the expected gross carry over one intended hold equals twice the tier-2.0 round trip; below kappa sizes shrink linearly toward zero.
mechanism.sizing_rule: w_i(t) = sign(Delta_r_i(t)) x min(1, |Delta_r_i(t)| / kappa). Fractional net-notional weight per pair, |w| <= 1, w > 0 = long the base currency of the pair quote convention.
mechanism.trade_trigger_hysteresis: At each decision clock, act only if |w_target - w_booked| >= 0.10 (equivalently a differential move >= 4.8 bps). The fill executes the notional delta at the next session; per-side cost is charged on the delta notional. Because Delta_r is constant between evidenced policy events, the trigger can only ever fire on or after an evidenced update crossing the band; no daily churn is structurally possible.
mechanism.exit_rule: w_target = 0 (differential sign flip or zero differential) forces a full unwind at the next session regardless of the hysteresis band.
mechanism.why_it_survives_doubled_costs_by_design: Three structural properties, none of which is a threshold tweak of any ancestor: (1) trades occur only at evidenced policy events, so the fill count is bounded by the event count of the pinned ledger, not by the clock; (2) the sizing denominator kappa is itself the tier-2.0 cost-equivalent differential, so re-pricing the world at doubled costs monotonically shrinks every position instead of invalidating it; (3) a 0.10 hysteresis band suppresses sub-band re-sizing churn. This is the front-door 'financing-aware position sizing' construction, stated in its own terms: the risk unit is a carry-to-cost budget, not a volatility regime.
mechanism.distinction_from_invalidated_ancestor: FXFV3-A6-P1 was a binary realized-volatility regime gate (LOW holds, HIGH unwinds) at full size with daily re-evaluation. This proposal has NO volatility input anywhere in entry or sizing, no regime classification, continuous fractional sizing, and an event-hysteresis trigger. Overlap with the ancestor is confined to the underlying information source (the policy-rate differential direction), which is the sanctioned region of the front door. A7-N must measure rank correlation BOTH against the V3 family2 anchor as scored AND against its evidenced-availability corrected books (158 differing decisions, 19 sign flips) and the D2 re-entry decision is made on those numbers, not on this paragraph.

must_hold_if_mechanism_is_real: The after-cost financing-adjusted expectancy of the anchor book is positive, and per-trade expectancy rises weakly monotonically across terciles of |Delta_r|/kappa at entry (stronger carry-to-cost budgets carry more per trade, not less).

Entries taken at |Delta_r| >= kappa earn, per position, expected gross carry over the realized holding interval that covers the tier-2.0 round trip with the preregistered SAFETY = 2 multiple on average (realized carry per trade >= 2 x 6 bps x realized_hold/63 on the full-size tranche).

The tier-2.0 stress book remains positive with the SAME direction logic: re-pricing costs does not flip the sign of any position, only its size, so the tier-2.0 book is a scaled-down twin of the base book.
The cross-pair derangement control (identical dates, sizes, fill machinery; signal permuted across pairs) fails to reproduce the anchor: control expectancy <= 0 or control PF < 1.10.
what_would_falsify_it: Per-trade expectancy is flat or decreasing in |Delta_r|/kappa terciles (the differential magnitude carries no after-cost information).
The derangement control matches the anchor within noise (the PnL came from the timing/sizing machinery or a USD-wide factor, not from pair-specific differential content).
The tier-2.0 book inverts sign while the base book is positive (costs, not carry, drove the base book).

universe.justification: Full authorized 7-pair universe, no subset. Both legs of every pair are in the 8-area evidenced-citable WS_CBPOL catalog, so every pair's differential is constructible under evidenced availability; USD is the common quote/base leg of the authorized universe. Excluding pairs would create cherry-picking risk that the front door explicitly forbids; pair dependence is probed by the drop-one suite instead.

warmup: 10 sessions. The differential is readable from the first decision clock of the window through the baseline levels (conservative, non-load-bearing); the warmup only initializes the hysteresis state (w_booked seeded to w_target at the first populated clock without a fill). No volatility or rolling statistic is used anywhere in this proposal, so no longer warmup is required.
holding_period: No fixed horizon. Positions persist while the evidenced differential persists; realized holding is event-bound (expected median holding several months during stable-rate regimes, weeks around dense policy cycles). The intended-minimum-hold constant H = 63 sessions enters only the budget arithmetic (kappa), not as a forced exit.
entry_rules: At the daily 16:00 America/New_York decision clock: compute Delta_r_i(t) from evidenced vintages; compute w_target_i; if |w_target_i - w_booked_i| >= 0.10, schedule a next-session fill to move w_i to w_target_i (entry from flat, re-size, or unwind-to-zero). No other trade condition exists.
exit_rules: Full unwind when w_target_i = 0 (differential crossed zero or magnitude zero), executed at the next session. No volatility, drawdown, or calendar exit exists in this proposal.
fill_convention: Every fill executes on the FIRST session bar strictly after its decision clock (next-session convention, 16:00 America/New_York session bars, DST-aware, authorized price-snapshot calendar). The decision-to-fill gap is exactly one session (1-4 calendar days across weekends/holidays), always inside the frozen validator's next-session/4-day constraint. No fill is ever scheduled at a lag that depends on evidence arrival; the only evidence dependence is WHICH trade the next session executes, never WHEN.

anchor.spec: The mechanism above exactly: kappa = 48 bps (SAFETY 2, tier-2.0 round trip, H 63), hysteresis band 0.10, no other filter.

neighbour.spec: Identical machinery with SAFETY = 3 (kappa = 72 bps): a stricter cost budget that concentrates the book in the strongest differentials.
neighbour.why_genuine_variant: It varies the cost-budget constant of THIS mechanism, not any ancestor parameter. If the mechanism is real (the carry-to-cost ratio carries after-cost information), the stricter budget should retain positive financing-adjusted expectancy; if expectancy only exists by relaxing toward the ancestor's construction, the neighbour dies with it.

causal_placebo_control.spec: Cross-pair derangement control: the anchor's w signal of pair j is traded on pair sigma(j) under the fixed cyclic remapping sigma over the alphabetical pair order [AUD/USD -> GBP/USD, GBP/USD -> NZD/USD, NZD/USD -> USD/CAD, USD/CAD -> USD/CHF, USD/CHF -> USD/JPY, USD/JPY -> EUR/USD, EUR/USD -> AUD/USD]. Decision dates, notional sizes, hysteresis state, fill machinery, costs and dual books are byte-identical to the anchor; only the signal-to-instrument mapping is permuted.
causal_placebo_control.fires_differently_how: Wherever mapped differentials disagree in sign or magnitude (frequent: e.g. 2024-2026 EMU-US around +315..+400 bps vs JP-US around +10..+60 bps), the control takes directions the anchor does not, at the same instants.
causal_placebo_control.runs_to_completion_proof: Its fill schedule IS the anchor's fill schedule: every fill is the next session after its decision clock, so if the anchor's book executes under the frozen validator, the control's book executes identically. Nothing in the control references evidence later than the anchor's own decision stamps; a ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION abort is structurally impossible (the V3R lesson: a refused control has null evidentiary value - this design cannot be refused).
causal_placebo_control.preregistered_rejection_rule: CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM if control financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND control PF >= 1.10 (frozen CONTROL_REJECT_PF). Then the anchor's PnL is not pair-specific differential content and the mechanism is falsified regardless of anchor profitability.

incremental_test.benchmark: Naive differential-direction book: daily 16:00 America/New_York clock, w = sign(Delta_r) whenever |Delta_r| > 0 else 0, full unit size, fills only when the sign of Delta_r changes, next-session convention, same frozen cost schedule, same dual-book accounting.
incremental_test.alpha_definition: per_trade_expectancy_difference_v1 (frozen family2 convention): anchor financing-adjusted per-trade expectancy minus benchmark financing-adjusted per-trade expectancy; gate passes only if > 0.
incremental_test.what_it_must_beat_and_why_it_is_the_righ: The differential-carry direction itself. The V3R observation says the direction is economically present; incremental alpha isolates whether the budget-scaled, event-hysteresis construction adds after-cost information beyond simply being long the high-rate leg. Positive raw PnL never overrides this gate.
incremental_test.stress_role: The benchmark book is scored on the same tier ladder; alpha is computed on financing-adjusted books at base tier, with tier-1.5/2.0 alpha reported alongside.

costs.base: 1.5 bps per side, charged exactly once per fill side (frozen kernel authority)
costs.stress_tiers: multipliers x1.5 and x2.0 applied to BOOKED stress PnL (F1-fixed convention): tier books re-price every fill at 2.25 / 3.0 bps per side (round trip 4.5 / 6.0 bps)
costs.break_even_reporting: break-even bps per cell (per-side bps at which financing-adjusted expectancy crosses zero), derived from the same kernel, reported at tier 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0; a cell whose tier-2.0 break-even is below 3.0 bps per side cannot pass the primary stress gate and is reported as such
costs.financing: dual book (price-only and financing-adjusted) with the frozen financing formula; the financing term must never manufacture the edge: if financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 while price-only expectancy <= 0, FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE fires

turnover_and_sample_floor.expected_decisions: 120-220 trades (entries + re-sizes + unwinds) across the 7-pair universe over 2019-01..2026-09; driven by the ~212 rate-change rows of the pinned ledger filtered through the 0.10 hysteresis band (~4.8 bps of differential move per act)
turnover_and_sample_floor.minimum_decisions_for_validity: frozen per-arm floor 40 scored decisions (MIN_DECISIONS_PER_ARM); below it the cell is DECISION_FLOOR_NOT_MET, a sample failure rather than a mechanistic reject
turnover_and_sample_floor.fold_population: 3 folds on the inherited frozen boundaries (2020-03-01, 2022-05-01, end 2026-09-02), purge 14 days, force-flat at boundaries; a fold is populated at >= 30 trades (frozen FOLD_POPULATED_MIN_TRADES); >= 2 positive populated folds required
turnover_and_sample_floor.honest_population_warning: Fold 1 (2019-01..2020-03, ~14 months) is event-poor for an event-bound book; it may fall below the 30-trade populated floor, reducing the gate to 2-of-2 populated folds positive. This is disclosed ex ante as a population risk, not a post hoc excuse.

drop_one_design.scenarios: 7 drop-one-PAIR exclusions (one per universe pair) + 1 drop-one-BEST-fold exclusion (fold with highest expectancy among populated folds; its trades removed, reduced-book expectancy recomputed) = 8 scenarios, frozen V3-I/M1-DEV convention
drop_one_design.survival_definition: a scenario survives if the reduced book's financing-adjusted expectancy > 0

failure_interpretation: A reject decomposes mechanistically: (1) INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE with a positive benchmark means the differential direction carries information but the budget-sizing construction adds none - the region may still be live for a different construction; (2) STRESS_TIER_2.0_FAIL means even event-bound, budget-scaled exposure cannot pay doubled costs in this region - the strongest possible cost-side kill for the whole carry axis and the front door should be considered exhausted; (3) CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM means the PnL came from timing/sizing machinery or a USD-wide factor, not pair-specific differential content - falsification of the mechanism claim itself; (4) DECISION_FLOOR_NOT_MET or FEWER_THAN_2_POSITIVE_POPULATED_FOLDS due to population (not sign) is an inconclusive sample failure, recorded as such and NOT re-run with loosened floors this cycle.

margin_to_fail_expectations.positive_populated_folds_ge_2_of_3: KNIFE-EDGE, with population risk: fold 1 may be unpopulated (< 30 trades), forcing 2-of-2 populated folds positive. Fold 2 (2020-03..2022-05) spans carry-compression losses; fold 3 holds the largest differentials.

margin_to_fail_expectations.fold_positive_share_le_50pct: KNIFE-EDGE; plausible fail. The last fold (2022-05..2026-09) contains the widest differentials of the window and plausibly most of the positive PnL; the best-fold share could exceed 0.50. Disclosed as a likely thin gate.
margin_to_fail_expectations.pair_concentration_le_40pct: KNIFE-EDGE; plausible fail. USD/JPY and USD/CHF carry the largest differentials over most of the window; one pair exceeding 40% of gross positive PnL is a realistic outcome of honest budget scaling.
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_tier_1.5_positive: Thin pass expected by design (event-bound fills, low turnover).
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_tier_2.0_positive_PRIMARY: Thin pass expected BY DESIGN, knife-edge not excluded. This is the gate that killed the ancestor (-101.62, PF 0.9881). My claim is structural: fills bounded by ledger events, sizes scaled by the tier-2.0 cost-equivalent kappa. Residual risk: 2019-2021 small-differential states still spend cost budget and the design targets survival, not profitability.
margin_to_fail_expectations.dropout_survival_ge_6_of_8: KNIFE-EDGE. Dropping USD/JPY or USD/CHF plausibly kills the book; only 2 tolerated failures.
margin_to_fail_expectations.usd_drift_corr_le_0.30: PLAUSIBLE FAIL, disclosed honestly. The evidenced differential direction is structurally USD-long through most of the window (US rates above EUR/JPY/CHF throughout, above AUD/NZD/CAD much of it); a differential-carry book on this universe cannot fully neutralize USD beta without abandoning the mechanism. |corr| > 0.30 is a realistic outcome.
margin_to_fail_expectations.incremental_alpha_gt_0: KNIFE-EDGE; the second most likely failure gate. The naive benchmark is itself low-turnover on this universe (direction changes only at events), so the bar is high; the edge must come from avoiding small-differential noise states. Central estimate: barely positive or zero.
margin_to_fail_expectations.neighbour_supports: Pass with margin expected: the SAFETY=3 book concentrates in the strongest differentials; if the anchor has any real edge the neighbour should share it.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_does_not_reproduce_AND_runs_to_c: Pass with margin. The derangement cannot execute differently from the anchor (identical fill schedule -> no validator abort possible) and destroys pair-specific mapping by construction; residual risk is incidental sign agreement across mapped pairs, which the expectancy/PF rule handles.
